honors.title: Anne E. Borghesani Memorial Prize
honors.description: Received grant to volunteer for 5 weeks and aid in the recovery efforts of Tacloban City in Leyte, Philippines after Typhoon Yolanda (Haiyan). I was provided the opportunity to interact with many of the victims of the disaster while performing manual labor to build both permanent and temporary shelters around the area.

honors.title: Empower Fellowship
honors.description: "The Empower Fellowship provides the opportunity for students to launch social enterprises, participate in internships and conduct applied research related to social entrepreneurship in international or local community development. The fellowship offers either a grant or stipend for students to pursue these opportunities and allows students to join the Social Entrepreneurship Network at Tufts, which encourages collaboration, mentorship, and the promotion of social entrepreneurship on campus."
honors.issuer: Issued by The Institute for Global Leadership at Tufts University · May 2014
